findings.text: §50's deliverable defines the generation key as "the tuple of its own project's generation, the generations of the mounted projects it reads, and the code stamp", but supplies no source and no cost for `the code stamp`, while the same section's done-when requires a repeat roadmap call to make "at most 10 stats" with `os.stat` counted by a wrapper; the tree's only code-stamp machinery, `reckon/served_code.py`'s `take_snapshot` (served_code.py:108) over `_source_files` (served_code.py:85), enumerates and stats the source tree, so on the plan's own text the third key component either is memoised somewhere the plan does not name or blows the 10-stat bound the same node must meet
